wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 05-003 wires the TEXTURE1/TEXTURE2/PNAMES lumps and the patch/flat marker-range catalogs into a single frozen runtime artifact downstream renderer steps consume. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/texturesAndFlats.ts imports parsePnames/parseTextureLump/buildPatchCatalog/buildFlatCatalog from the read-only src/assets/ parsers, finds the PNAMES and TEXTURE1 entries via IwadResourceCache.findLump, treats TEXTURE2 as optional (absent in shareware DOOM 1.9), and walks the directory's P_START..P_END and F_START..F_END marker ranges. Failure modes (missing lumps, malformed lumps, missing markers) surface as typed TexturesAndFlatsError instances with a stable TexturesAndFlatsErrorReason discriminator.
publicSurface: TexturesAndFlatsResources interface (flatCatalog, patchCatalog, patchNames, textures1, textures2)
TexturesAndFlatsError extends Error (reason: TexturesAndFlatsErrorReason, identifier: string)

TexturesAndFlatsErrorReason union (flat-markers-missing | patch-markers-missing | pnames-lump-malformed | pnames-lump-missing | texture1-lump-malformed | texture1-lump-missing | texture2-lump-malformed)
